title: World Errosion
description: Ever selected number of seconds, the top layer of all surrounding chunks will be removed
body:
# 🌍 World Erosion

The world is slowly dying. Every surface block vanishes over time — terrain, builds, structures, everything. How long can you survive?

## What does it do?

At a set interval, the highest block in every loaded chunk column is removed. The ground beneath your feet literally disappears. No block is safe — terrain, trees, buildings, villages — everything erodes equally.

## Commands

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| `/erosion start <seconds>` | Start erosion with a wave every X seconds |
| `/erosion pause` | Freeze the timer |
| `/erosion resume` | Continue the countdown |
| `/erosion stop` | Stop erosion completely |
| `/erosion accelerate <factor%> <minSec>` | Make waves get progressively faster |

## Features

⏱ Live HUD countdown above the hotbar — turns red at 3 seconds remaining

🔔 Warning sound before each erosion wave

⚡ Accelerating mode — erosion speeds up over time for an intense challenge

🌍 Works in all dimensions — Overworld, Nether, and End

🛡 Protected blocks — Bedrock, Command Blocks, Barriers, and Structure Voids are never removed

🚀 Performance optimised — only processes currently loaded chunks

## Requirements

- Minecraft 1.21.4
- Fabric Loader
- Fabric API

Featured in a video by Divinxxii
